constraints.description: The core runtime ledger must retain the root exports and exactly match the built optional ./devtools entry point.

validation.validation_method: Run the scoped core skills-ledger verifier and compare the generated diff with the two intended new runtime projection exports.

constraints.description: Public content must match entity, view, relationship, preview, restore, revision, and lifecycle semantics in production source.

validation.validation_method: Compare README and skills/API references with protocol.ts, controller.ts, inspection.ts, views.ts, relationships.ts, and previews.ts.

constraints.description: The security receipt must state metadata-only value hiding, remaining identifier/topology exposure, host transport authority, preview mutation limits, conflicts, and per-store lifecycle.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the security receipt against command parsing, value projection, controller ownership, and preview implementation.

constraints.description: Every package, consumer, fixture, and scenario status must pass and both fixture sources must be byte-identical at the recorded SHA-256.

validation.validation_method: Parse task-9-packed-acceptance.json, recursively reject non-pass statuses, compare fixtures byte-for-byte, and recompute both hashes.

constraints.description: Entity-inspection readiness must not be presented as completion of later phase changes or publication.

validation.validation_method: Require explicit exclusions for time travel, React/Flutter inspectors, extensions, site, certification, and publication.

global_rules: Refinement may correct documentation or observed implementation defects but may not broaden production scope.
Only the completed assembled packed-consumer gate counts as behavioral evidence.
Do not create or run unit, component, isolated, mock-backed, snapshot, or partial tests.
Do not imply package publication or full DevTools product certification.
termination_conditions: All five blocking constraints are satisfied.
No further delta improves truthfulness, security clarity, or traceability.
